sentences.text: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma

The instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed on behalf of petitioner seeking quashing of FIR bearing No. 227/2019, registered at Police Station Anand Vihar for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
2.
It is stated by learned APP for the State that Sh. Jagmohan Singh Duggal and Smt. Jagdessh Duggal i.e. Father-in-law and Mother-in-law of the complainant respectively.
The accused chargesheeted, however, they have not been made party in the present petition.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner, however he states that the complaint who is present in person today cannot appear on the next date of hearing as she is leaving India tomorrow morning.

4. Complaint is present and I have asked the complaint as to whether she has settled all the claims against the petitioner including the two petitioners who are not made party of the present petition as of now.
She states that she has settled all the claims with father-in-law and mother-in-law also.
She also states that in case they will be impleaded as parties, she will have no objection to the FIR being quashed.
5. In view thereof, the complaint stands discharged.
